title: Block Out Level 20 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 20 is a two-room boss puzzle centered on a huge purple `5` block. Prepare the lower room, keep the green stem free, reduce the frame counters around the boss, and only then let the upper chamber resolve.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 20 is a two-room boss puzzle centered on a huge purple `5` block. Prepare the lower room, keep the green stem free, reduce the frame counters around the boss, and only then let the upper chamber resolve.
landmarks: Block Out Level 20 is a two-room boss puzzle centered on a huge purple `5` block.
Prepare the lower room, keep the green stem free, reduce the frame counters around the boss, and only then let the upper chamber resolve.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: The lower room is support work for the upper boss.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear space around the yellow bottom gate in the lower room so the first counters begin to fall.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Rotate the red and blue lower-room blocks without pinning the central green stem.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Keep the purple `5` parked in the upper chamber while the top frame counters drop.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Use the lower room to keep feeding the sides of the upper chamber until the boss frame is almost open.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Free the green stem only after the lower room has enough empty space to absorb the next moves.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Let the upper chamber finish once the purple `5` block is no longer locked by the frame.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: End with the last lower-room colors after the boss block has already cleared.

failurePoints: Blocking the green connector with a lower-room color block.
Trying to move the purple `5` while the frame counters are still high.
